deduplicated.reason: One earliest eligible decision per property/night. The per-decision score remains the primary panel.

estimated_revenue.assumption: bookings do not respond to price (price-swap only) — not a causal result

label_definition: For a decision on D for stay date S, label booked=true iff a confirmed booking event occurs after D and on or before min(S, censor); already-booked-at-D nights are excluded and reported separately.
price_ref_note: 56 logged decision(s) had no listed price in the decision-day pacing snapshot; they are marked listed_source=none and excluded from reference-price comparisons.
warnings: Rows repeat the same stay night across decision days; see deduplicated calibration.
